findings.summary: auth.login/auth.refresh do not set allowPublic; will fail if main.ts attaches authn globally to /api/* per task-app-main
findings.suggested_fix: Either set c.set('allowPublic', true) early in login/refresh handlers, or document that wireAuth mounts on a sub-router placed before global authn

findings.summary: Imports use .ts extension (TS5097) instead of sprint-wide .js convention; compounds existing tsc -b breakage
findings.suggested_fix: Replace '../../shared/errors.ts', './passwords.ts', './service.ts' specifiers with .js equivalents to match the rest of apps/api/src

findings.summary: vi.mock('../../shared/env.ts') specifier does not literally match service.ts import '../../shared/env.js'; relies on vitest path normalization
findings.suggested_fix: Change the mock specifier to '../../shared/env.js' so it matches the production import string exactly

findings.summary: AuthRouterVars uses string for role; @medbridge/contracts already exports a role union that could be reused for type safety
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `user: { userId: string; role: string }` with the inferred type derived from contracts userShape (role enum)

findings.summary: wireAuth uses Hono<any> with biome-ignore; could accept a parameterised AppEnv to preserve variable typing across modules
findings.suggested_fix: Introduce a shared AppEnv type and parameterise wireAuth(router: Hono<AppEnv>, deps); remove the any suppression

findings.summary: Test mocks ./tokens.ts wholesale, so the session-token mint/verify path is never exercised in this unit suite
findings.suggested_fix: Acceptable for unit scope; rely on tokens.test.ts (wave-4) and integration tests (wave-10) for end-to-end token coverage
